_meta.note: Test fixture for npc-story-events NR1.2 (the real file is narrative-seed's).

required.description: The role must cast, or the storylet leaves the pool.
required.negative: Not a score; scoring over the save's facts is the runtime's casting.

optional.description: The role is cast when it can be.
optional.negative: Not a requirement; an uncalled optional role never removes the storylet.

forbidden.description: A character matching the tags must not be present.
forbidden.negative: Not a filter on who is offered; it removes the storylet.

none.description: No role kind fits; the structure draft is refused and re-asked.
none.negative: Not an empty role; it is the model's way to say no kind fits.

source.description: Where the character comes from: the party, a named seed, or the wild.
source.negative: Not a provenance the runtime stores; it is a casting filter.

side.description: Which side the character stands on.
side.negative: Not a species; a plant and a plant-type zombie are different sides.

element.negative: Not a damage type; it is the one element vocabulary.

characterRole.description: The character's role in the character registry.
characterRole.negative: Not a storylet-local role id; these are the shared registry's roles.
